G4800.def:
συν-ζάω (Rec. συζ-), 
to live with: opposite to συναποθανεῖν, 2 Corinthiens 7:3; of life in union with Christ, here and hereafter, Romains 6:8, 2 Timothée 2:11.†

G4801.def:
συν-ζεύγνυμι
(Rec. συζ-), [in LXX: Eze.1:11, 23 (חָבַר) * ;] 
to yoke to­gether: metaphorically, of union in wedlock, Matthieu 19:6, Marc 10:9.†

G4802.def:
συν-ζητέω
(Rec. συζ-), -ῶ, [in LXX: Néhémie 2:4 AB1 (בָּקַשׁ pi.) * ;] 
__1. to search or examine together (Plat.). 
__2. In NT (and π., see MM, xxiii; also in MGr., see Kennedy, Sources, 155), to discuss, dispute: Marc 1:27 12:28, Luc 24:15; before quæst. indir., Marc 9:10; with dative of person(s), Marc 8:11 Actes 6:9; before πρός, with accusative of person(s), Marc 9:14, 16, Actes 9:29; id. before quæst. indir., Luc 22:23.†

G4803.def:
συν-ζήτηαις (Rec. συζ-), -εως, ἡ 
disputation: Actes 28:29 (WH, R, txt., om.).†

G4804.def:
συν-ζητητής (Rec. συζ-), -οῦ, ἁ 
(συνζητέω), 
a disputer, disputant: 1 Corinthiens 1:20.†

G4805.def:
σύν-ζυγος (Rec. ουζ-), or as WH, mg., Σύνζυγος, -ον 
(συνζεύγνυμι), [in Aq., Eze.23:21 * ;] 
a yoke fellow. Prob., as proper name, Σ. γνήσιε, genuinely Synzygus, S. properly so-called, Philippiens 4:3 (see ICC, Lft., in l; MM, xxiii).†

G4806.def:
συν-ζωο-ποιέω (Rec. συζ-), ῶ-, 
to make alive or quicken together with; metaphorically, of the spiritual life: τ. Χριστῷ, Éphésiens 2:5; σὺν τ. Χ., Colossiens 2:13.†

G4807.def:
συκάμινος, -ου, ἡ 
[in LXX for שִׁקְמָה (pl.) ;] 
the mulberry tree 
(Lat. morus; cf. μόρον, 1Ma.6:34 *), 
the sycamine: Luc 17:6. (In LXX, σ. appears to represent the συκόμορος (see: συκομορέα), but St. Luke distinguishes between the two; see ICC, in l; DB, iv, 634.) †

G4808.def:
συκῆ (contr. fr. συκέα), -ῆς, ἡ 
(σῦκον), [in LXX for תְּאֵן ;] 
a fig-tree: Matthieu 21:19-21 24:32, Marc 11:13, 20-21 13:28, Luc 13:6-7 21:29, Jean 1:49, 51, Jacques 3:12, Apocalypse 6:13.†

G4809.def:
συκο-μορέα (Rec. -μωραία, L, -μωρέα), -ας, ἡ, more commonly (so Aq., Sm., Psaumes 78:47, Ésaïe 9:10) συκόμορος 
(σῦκον + μόρον, the black mulberry), 
a fig-mulberry, a sycamore: Luc 19:4 (cf. συκάμινος).†

G4810.def:
σῦκον, -ου, τό 
[in LXX for תְּאֵן ] 
a fig: Matthieu 7:16, Marc 11:13, Luc 6:44 Jacques 3:12.†

G4811.def:
συκοφαντέω, -ῶ
(σῦκον, φαίνω), [in LXX: Genèse 43:18 (גָּלַל hithpo.), Lévitique 19:11 (שָׁקַר pi.), Job 35:9, Psaumes 119:122, Proverbes 14:31 2:16 28:3, Ecclésiaste 4:1 (עָשַׁק) ;] 
to act the συκοφάντης (on conjectures as to the origin of the term, see LS, see word), to accuse falsely (Aristoph., Xen., al.): Luc 3:14 (R, mg.) Luc 19:8 (RV, exact wrongfully; but cf. Hatch, Essays, 89 ff., see also Field, Notes, 56 f.; MM, xxiv).†

G4812.def:
συλαγωγέω, -ῶ
(σύλη, booty + ἄγω), 
to carry off as spoil, lead captive (θυγατέρα, Heliod., Aeth., 10, 35): metaphorically, Colossiens 2:8.†

G4813.def:
συλάω, -ῶ 
[in LXX: Ep. Jérémie 1:18 * ;] 
with accusative of person(s), to strip, plunder, spoil: 2 Corinthiens 11:8.†

G4814.def: to talk or converse with another, (New Testament) (ML)

G4815.def:
συλ-λαμβάνω 
[in LXX for תָּפַשׂ, הָרָה, etc. ;] 
__1. with accusative, to bring together, collect. 
__2. to seize, take: with accusative of person(s), as a prisoner, Matthieu 26:55, Marc 14:48, Luc 22:54, Jean 18:12, Actes 1:16 12:3; pass., Actes 23:27; mid., in sense of act., Actes 26:21; σ. ἄγραν ἰχθύων, Luc 5:9. 
__3. C. dative of person(s), to take part with, assist, succour; mid., in same sense: Luc 5:7, Philippiens 4:3. 
__4. Of a woman, to conceive: absol., Luc 1:24; before ἐν γαστρί, Luc 1:31; with accusative, Luc 1:36; ib. before ἐν τ. κοιλίᾳ, Luc 2:21; metaphorically, of lust producing sin, Jacques 1:15.†

G4816.def:
συλ-λέγω 
[in LXX chiefly for לָקַט ;] 
to bring together, collect, gather up: with accusative of thing(s), Matthieu 13:28-30; pass., Matthieu 13:40; with accusative, before ἀπό, Matthieu 7:16; id. before ἐκ, Matthieu 13:41, Luc 6:44; before εἰς, Matthieu 13:48.†

G4817.def:
συλ-λογίζομαι 
[in LXX chiefly for חָשַׁב pi. ;] 
__1. to compute. 
__2. to reason: Luc 20:5.†

G4818.def:
συν-λυπέω
(Rec. συλλ-), -ῶ, [in LXX: Psaumes 69:20, Ésaïe 51:19 (נוּד) * ;] 
to make to grieve with (Arist.). Pass., to be moved to grief by sympathy: before ἐπί, with dative, Marc 3:5.†

G4819.def:
συμ-βαίνω 
[in LXX for עָשָׂה, קָרָא, קָרָה, etc. ;] 
__1. to stand with the feet together. 
__2. to come together, come to terms. 
__3. Of events, to come to pass, happen: with dative of person(s), Marc 10:32, Actes 3:10 20:19, 1 Corinthiens 10:11, 1 Pierre 4:12, 2 Pierre 2:22; absol., τὰ σνμβεβηκότα, Luc 24:14 (cf. 1Ma.4:26); with accusative and nf., Actes 21:35.†

G4821.def:
συμ-βουλεύω 
[in LXX chiefly for יָעַץ ;] 
__1. to advise, counsel: with dative of person(s), Jean 18:14; id. before inf., Apocalypse 3:18. 
__2. Mid., to take counsel, consult: before ἵνα, Matthieu 26:4 ("reciprocal middle," see M, Pr., 157); with inf., Actes 9:23.†

G4822.def:
συν-βιβάζω
(Rec. συμ-), [in LXX: Exode 4:12, 15, Lévitique 10:11, Juges 13:8, Psaumes 32:8 (יָרָה hi.); Exode 18:16, Deutéronome 4:9, Ésaïe 40:13 (יָדַע hi.), Ésaïe 40:14 (בִּין hi.), Da TH Daniel 9:22 (שָׂכַל hi.) * ;] 
__1. to join or knit together, unite: Éphésiens 4:16, Colossiens 2:2 (but see infr.), Colossiens 2:19. 
__2. to compare, consider, conclude (Plat.): Actes 16:10. 
__3. to deduce, prove, demonstrate (Arist.): Actes 9:22. 
__4. As in LXX ("translation Greek," = ἐμβιβάζω, metaphorically), to teach, instruct: 1 Corinthiens 2:16 Actes 19:33, R, mg. (also in Vg., Colossiens 2:2, instructi, but see supr.).†

G4823.def:
1. to advise, counsel , Lat. consulere alicui, with dative pers. et infinitive, to advise one to do a thing, (Herdotus Historicus), etc. 
2. without the infinitive, ς. τινί τι (Herdotus Historicus); ς. τι to recommend a measure, (Herdotus Historicus), attic:—;Pass., τὰ συμβουλευόμενα the advice given , (Xenophon Historicus) 
3. absolute to advise, give advice , (Sophocles Tragicus); ὁ συμβουλεύων or -εύσας, an adviser , Lat. auctor sententiae, (Aristotle Philosopher) 
4. Mid. to consult with a person, i. e. ask his advice , Lat. consulere aliquem, with dative, (Herdotus Historicus), etc.: absolute to consult, deliberate , (Xenophon Historicus) (ML)

G4824.def:
συμβούλιον, -ου, τό
(σύμβουλος), [in LXX: 4Ma.17:17 א * ;] 
a word of the Græco-Roman period (of. Lat. consilium, and see Deiss., BS, 238) = cl. συμβουλία (Arist., Xen.), 
__1. counsel: σ. λαμβάνειν, Matthieu 12:14 22:15 27:7 28:12; διδόναι, Marc 3:6 (ποιεῖν, Rec.); ποιεῖν, Marc 15:1 (ἑτοιμάζειν, WH, mg.). 
__2. By meton., a council (4Mac, l.with א; συνέδριον, AR): Actes 25:12 (see MM, xxiv).†

G4825.def:
σύμβουλος, -ου, ὁ
(σύν, βουλή), [in LXX for יָעַץ and cogn. forms ;] 
a counsellor, adviser: Romains 11:34 (LXX).†

G4826G.def:
Συμεών, ὁ indecl., (Heb. שִׁמְעוֹן), 
Simeon (so always AV; RV in Luc 2:25, 34 only), Symeon, a Heb. name for which the Gk. Σίμων, which see, was also used; 
__1. the son of Jacob (Genèse 29:33): Apocalypse 7:7. 
__2. An ancestor of our Lord: Luc 3:30 
__3. An aged worshipper in the Temple: Luc 2:25, 34. 
__4. One surnamed Niger: Actes 13:1. 
__5. The apostle Peter: Actes 15:14, 2 Pierre 1:1 (R, txt., WH, txt., Σίμων).†

G4826H.def:
Συμεών, ὁ indecl., (Heb. שִׁמְעוֹן), 
Simeon (so always AV; RV in Luc 2:25, 34 only), Symeon, a Heb. name for which the Gk. Σίμων, which see, was also used; 
__1. the son of Jacob (Genèse 29:33): Apocalypse 7:7. 
__2. An ancestor of our Lord: Luc 3:30 
__3. An aged worshipper in the Temple: Luc 2:25, 34. 
__4. One surnamed Niger: Actes 13:1. 
__5. The apostle Peter: Actes 15:14, 2 Pierre 1:1 (R, txt., WH, txt., Σίμων).†

G4826I.def:
Συμεών, ὁ indecl., (Heb. שִׁמְעוֹן), 
Simeon (so always AV; RV in Luc 2:25, 34 only), Symeon, a Heb. name for which the Gk. Σίμων, which see, was also used; 
__1. the son of Jacob (Genèse 29:33): Apocalypse 7:7. 
__2. An ancestor of our Lord: Luc 3:30 
__3. An aged worshipper in the Temple: Luc 2:25, 34. 
__4. One surnamed Niger: Actes 13:1. 
__5. The apostle Peter: Actes 15:14, 2 Pierre 1:1 (R, txt., WH, txt., Σίμων).†

G4826J.def:
Συμεών, ὁ indecl., (Heb. שִׁמְעוֹן), 
Simeon (so always AV; RV in Luc 2:25, 34 only), Symeon, a Heb. name for which the Gk. Σίμων, which see, was also used; 
__1. the son of Jacob (Genèse 29:33): Apocalypse 7:7. 
__2. An ancestor of our Lord: Luc 3:30 
__3. An aged worshipper in the Temple: Luc 2:25, 34. 
__4. One surnamed Niger: Actes 13:1. 
__5. The apostle Peter: Actes 15:14, 2 Pierre 1:1 (R, txt., WH, txt., Σίμων).†

G4826K.def:
Συμεών, ὁ indecl., (Heb. שִׁמְעוֹן), 
Simeon (so always AV; RV in Luc 2:25, 34 only), Symeon, a Heb. name for which the Gk. Σίμων, which see, was also used; 
__1. the son of Jacob (Genèse 29:33): Apocalypse 7:7. 
__2. An ancestor of our Lord: Luc 3:30 
__3. An aged worshipper in the Temple: Luc 2:25, 34. 
__4. One surnamed Niger: Actes 13:1. 
__5. The apostle Peter: Actes 15:14, 2 Pierre 1:1 (R, txt., WH, txt., Σίμων).†

G4827.def:
συν-μαθητής (Rec. συμμ-), -οῦ, ὁ 
a fellow-disciple: Jean 11:16 (on the use of συν- in such compounds as this, see Rutherford, NPhr., 255 f.).†

G4828.def:
συν-μαρτυρέω (Rec. συμμ-), -ῶ, 
to bear witness with: Romains 2:15; with dative, Romains 8:16; before ὅτι, Romains 9:1.†

G4829.def:
συν-μερίζω
(Rec. συμμ-), [in LXX: Proverbes 29:24 א2 (חָלַק) * ;] 
to distri­bute in shares. Mid., to have a share in: 1 Corinthiens 9:13 (Diod., al.).†

G4830.def:
συν-μέτοχος (Rec. συμμ-), -ον, 
partaking together with; as subst., ὁ σ., a joint partaker (with dative of person(s) and genitive of thing(s), FlJ, BJ, i, 24, 6): with genitive of thing(s), Éphésiens 3:6; with genitive of person(s), Éphésiens 5:7 (Arist.).†

G4831.def:
συν-μιμητής (Rec. συμμ-), -οῦ, ὁ 
a fellow-imitator: with genitive obj., Philippiens 3:17 (see ICC, in l). Not elsewhere.†

G4832.def:
σύμ-μορφος, -ον
(σύν, μορφή), 
__1. absol., similar (Luc.). 
__2. con­formed to: with dative, Philippiens 3:21; with genitive, Romains 8:29 (see B1., § 36, 11; 37, 6).†

G4833.def: Pass. to be conformed to , τινι (New Testament) (ML)

G4834.def:
συν-παθέω
(Rec. συμπ-), -ῶ, [in LXX: 4Ma.5:25 AR 4Ma.13:23 * ;] 
to have a fellow feeling for or with, sympathize with or in: with dative of thing(s), Hébreux 4:15; dative of person(s), Hébreux 10:34 (Arist., Plut., al.).†

G4835.def:
συμπαθής, -ές
(σύν, πάσχω) [in LXX: Job 29:25 A (אָבֵל), 4Ma.5:25 א, 4Ma.13:23 4Mac 15:4 * ;] 
__1. affected by like feelings, sympathetic: 1 Pierre 3:8. 
__2. exciting sympathy (Jb, l.with; Dion. H.).†

G4836.def:
συν-παρα-γίνομαι
(Rec. συμπ-), [in LXX: Psaumes 83:8 (לָוָה ni.) * ;] 
__1. to come up or be present together: before ἐπί, Luc 23:48. 
__2. to come up to assist (Thuc., al.; 2 Timothée 4:16, Rec.).†

G4837.def:
συν-παρα-καλέω (Rec. συμπ-), -ῶ, 
to call upon or exhort together (Plat.). Pass., to be strengthened or comforted with and among: Romains 1:12.†

G4838.def:
συν-παρα-λαμβάνω
(Rec. συμπ-), [in LXX: Genèse 19:17 (סָפָה ni.), Job 1:4 (שָׁלַח ni), 3Ma.1:1 * ;] 
to take along with: as a companion, with accusative, Actes 12:25 15:37-38 (on the tenses, see M, Pr., 130), Galates 2:1.†

G4840.def:
συν-πάρειμι
(Rec. σνμπ-), [in LXX: Tob.12:12 ΑΒ, Proverbes 8:27 (?), Wis.9:10 * ;] 
to be present together or with: with dative of person(s), Actes 25:24.†

G4841.def:
συν-πάσχω
(Rec. συμπ-), [in Al.: 1 Rois 22:8 * ;] 
__1. to suffer together or with: Romains 8:17, 1 Corinthiens 12:28. 
__2. to sympathize with (Plat., Arist.).†

G4842.def:
συν-πέμπω (Rec. συμπ-) 
to send together with: with accusative and dative, 2 Corinthiens 8:22; id. before μετά, with genitive, 2 Corinthiens 8:18.†

G4843.def:
συν-περι-λαμβάνω (Rec. συμπ-), 
__1. to enclose (Eze.5:3 (צוּר) *). 
__2. to embrace: with accusative of person(s), Actes 20:10.†

G4844.def:
συμπόσιον, -ου, τό
(συμπίνω), [in LXX: Esther 7:7 (מִשְׁתֶּה יַיִן) Esther 4:17, 1Ma.16:16, 2Ma.2:27, 3Ma.4:16 3Mac 5:36 3Mac 6:33; σ. οἴνου, Sir 34:31 (31:31) Sir.35:5 (32:5), Sir.49:1 * ;] 
__1. a drinking party 
__2. By meton., of the party itself, the guests (Plut); pl., σ. σ. (colloq.; see M, Pr., 97), in parties or companies: Marc 6:39.†

G4845.def:
συν-πληρόω
(Rec. συμπ-), -ῶ, [in LXX: Jérémie 25:12 (נָפַל) * ;] 
__1. to fill up completely (Thuc., of manning ships): of a ship filling with water, and by meton., of those on board, Luc 8:23. 
__2. to complete, fulfil: of time (Je, l.with, and see MM, xxiv), Luc 9:51, Actes 2:1 (on the "durative inf.," see M, Pr., 233).†

G4846.def:
συν-πνίγω (Rec. συμπ-), 
to choke: of thronging by a crowd, Luc 8:42. Fig., of seed, τ. λόγον, Matthieu 13:22, Marc 4:7, 19, Luc 8:14.†

G4847.def:
συν-πολίτης (Rec. σνμπ-), -ου, ὁ 
a fellow-citizen: pl., σ. τ. ἁγίων, opposite to ξένοι κ. πάροικοι, Éphésiens 2:19 (Eur.; C.I., 6446; condemned by Atticists; see Rutherford, NPhr., 255 f.).†

G4848.def:
συν-πορεύομαι
(Rec. σνμπ-), [in LXX chiefly for הָלַךְ ;] 
__1. to journey together (Plat., al.): with dative of person(s), Luc 7:11 14:25 24:15. 
__2. to come together: Marc 10:1 (Plut., al.).†

G4849.def:
1. a drinking-party, symposium , (Theognis Elegiacus), etc. 
2. the room in which such parties were given, drinking-room , (Lucian) (ML)

G4850.def:
συν-πρεσβύτερος (Rec. συμπ-), -ου, ὁ 
a fellow-elder: 1 Pierre 5:1 (Eccl.).†

G4851.def:
συμ-φέρω 
[in LXX: Jérémie 33:14 (טוֹב), Proverbes 19:10 (נָאוֶה), Sir.30:19, al. ;] 
__1. trans. to bring together: with accusative of thing(s), Actes 19:19. 
__2. Intrans., and mostly impers., συμφέρει, it is expedient, profitable or an advantage: 1 Corinthiens 6:12 10:23, 2 Corinthiens 8:10; with inf. (M, Pr., 210), Matthieu 19:10, Jean 18:14; with dative, before ἵνα (Bl., § 69, 5), Matthieu 5:29-30 18:6, Jean 11:50 16:7. Ptcp., ςυμφέρων, profitable: 1 Corinthiens 12:7; pl., Actes 20:20; (οὐ σ. sc. ἐστιν; = οὐ συμφέρει; cf. Thuc., iii, 44, 2), 2 Corinthiens 12:1; as subst., τὸ σ., profit, Hébreux 12:10.†

G4852.def:
σύν φημι (Rec. συμ-), 
to consent, confess: with dative, before ὅτι, Romains 7:16.†

G4853.def:
συμ-φυλέτης, -ου, ὁ
(σύν, φυλή; cf. σύμφυλος, Aq.: Zacharie 13:7; and see Rutherford, NPhr., 255 f.) 
a fellow-tribesman, fellow-countryman: 1 Thessaloniciens 2:14 (see M, Th., in l, and Intr. liii). Not found elsewhere.†

G4854.def:
σύμ-φυτος, -ον
(συμφύω, to make to grow together) [in LXX: Zacharie 11:2 (בָּצַר), Esther 7:7 Esther 7:8 א2, Amos 9:13, 3Ma.3:22 * ;] 
__1. congenital, innate (Plat., al.; 3Mac, l.with). 
__2. grown along with, united with: τ. ὁμοιώματι τ. θανάτου αὐτσῦ (see Field, Notes, 155 f.), Romains 6:5.†

G4855.def:
συν-φύω
(Rec. συμ-), [in LXX: Wis.13:13 * ;] 
to cause to grow together. Pass., to grow together or with (Plat. al.): Luc 8:7.†

G4856.def:
συμ-φωνέω, -ῶ, 
[in LXX: Genèse 14:3 (H2266) 2 Rois 12:8 (9) (H225 ni.), Ésaïe 7:2 (H5117), 4Ma.14:6 * ;] 
prop., to agree in sound, be in harmony (Plat., Arist.). Metaphorical, 
__(a) to agree with, agree together: Luc 5:36; with dative of thing(s), Actes 15:15; before περί, Matthieu 18:19; pass., with dative of person(s), συνεφωνήθη ὑμῖν, Actes 5:9; 
__(b) to agree as to a price (Polyb., Diod.): with dative of person(s), genitive pret., Matthieu 20:13; before μετά . . . ἐκ, Matthieu 20:2.†

G4857.def:
συμ-φώνησις, -εως, ἡ
(συμφωνέω), 
concord, agreement: before πρός, with accusative of person(s), 2 Corinthiens 6:15.†

G4858.def:
συμφωνία, -ας, ἡ
(σύμφωνος), [in LXX: Dan LXX TH Daniel 3:5, 15, TH Daniel 3:7, 10 (סוּמְפּוֹנְיָה) 4Ma.14:3 A * ;] 
__1. symphony, music: Luc 15:25 
__2. a musical instrument (Polyb., al.; Da, ll. with; v MM, xxiv).†

G4859.def:
σύμφωνος, -ον
(ούν, φωνή), [in LXX: Ecclésiaste 7:14 (עֻמָּה), 4Ma.7:7 4Mac 14:7 * ;] 
agreeing in sound. Metaphorical, harmonious, agreeing: ἐκ συμφώνου (for exx. from π., see Deiss., BS, 255), by agreement, 1 Corinthiens 7:5.†

G4860.def:
συμ-ψηφίζω 
[in LXX: Jérémie 29:20 (Jérémie 49:20) A * ;] 
to reckon together, count up: Actes 19:19.†

G4861.def:
σύν-ψυχος (Rec. συμ-), -ον 
(ψυχή), 
of one mind: Philippiens 2:2.†

G4862.def:
σύν (old Att. ξύν), 
prep. with dative, 
expressing association, fellowship and inclusion. It gradually gave way to μετά, with genitive (cf. LS, see word; Bl., §41, 3), and is therefore comparatively infrequent in NT, being rare in Mat.4, Mrk.6, Jhn.3, and elsewhere (exx. Jacques 1:11, 2 Pierre 1:18) only in Lk (Gosp. and Ac) and Paul. With, together with: of companionship and association, Luc 2:13, Jean 21:3, Actes 10:23, al.; εἶναι σύν τινι, Luc 7:12, Actes 4:13, Philippiens 1:23, al.; of partisanship, Actes 4:13; οἱ σύν τινι, of attendants, companions or colleagues, Marc 2:26, Luc 5:9, Actes 5:17, al.; of assistance, ἡ χάρις τ. θεοῦ σὺν ἐμοί, 1 Corinthiens 15:10; of two or more things together, almost = καί, Luc 23:11, Actes 3:4 10:2 14:5 23:25, Éphésiens 3:18; σὺν Χριστῷ ζῆν, 2 Corinthiens 13:4; besides (FlJ, LXX), σὺν πᾶσι τούτοις, Luc 24:21. In composition: with (συνχαίρω), together (συνωδίνω), altogether (συντελέω)

G4863.def:
συν-άγω 
[in LXX chiefly for אָסַף, also for קָבַץ, etc. (cf. Kennedy, Sources, 128) ;] 
to gather or bring together: of things, Jean 6:12-13; before εἰς, Matthieu 3:12, al.; ἐκεῖ, Luc 12:18; ποῦ, Luc 12:17; συναγαγὼν πάντα (sc. εἰς ἀργύριον; see Field, Notes, 68, MM, xxiv), having sold off all: Luc 15:13; of persons, Jean 11:52; esp. of assemblies, Matthieu 2:4, Jean 11:47, Actes 14:27, al. Pass., to be gathered or come together: Matthieu 22:41, Marc 2:2, Luc 22:66, al.; before ἐπί Marc 5:21, Actes 4:27; πρός, Matthieu 13:2, Marc 4:1, al.; εἰς, Apocalypse 19:17; ἐν, Actes 11:26; μετά, Matthieu 28:12; οὗ, Matthieu 18:20; ὅπου, Matthieu 26:57; ἐκεῖ, Jean 18:2, al. 
In late writers (see Kennedy, Sources, 128; cf. Deutéronome 22:2, al.), to receive hospitably, entertain: Matthieu 25:35, 38 25:43 (cf. ἐπι-συνάγω)

G4865.def:
συν-αγωνίζομαι 
to strive together with, to help (prop., of sharing in a contest): with dative of person(s) and of thing(s), Romains 15:30.†

G4866.def:
συν-αθλέω, -ῶ 
= συναγωνίζομαι: with dative commod., Philippiens 1:27; with dative of person(s), before ἐν, Philippiens 4:3.†

G4867.def:
συν-αθροίζω 
[in LXX chiefly for קָבַץ ;] 
to gather together, assemble: with accusative of person(s), Actes 19:25; pass., Actes 12:12.†
ἀθροίζω 
(ἀθρόος, assembled in crowds, MM, VGT, see word; θρόος, a noise, tumult), [in LXX chiefly for קָבַץ ;] 
to Gather, assemble: Luc 24:33.†

G4868.def:
συν-αίρω 
[in LXX: Exode 23:5 (עָזַב) * ;] 
to take up together: σ. λόγον (of which there are several exx. in π.; see Deiss., LAE, 118 f.; MM, i, xxiv; M, Pr., 160), to settle accounts, Matthieu 18:23-24; before μετά, C. genitive of person(s), Matthieu 25:19.†

G4869.def:
συν-αιχμάλωτος, -ου, ὁ 
a fellow prisoner (prop., of a captive in war, see Lft., Col., 234): Romains 16:7, Colossiens 4:10, Phm 23.†

G4870.def:
συν-ακολουθέω, -ῶ 
[in LXX: 2Ma.2:4 2Mac 2:6 * ;] 
to follow along with, accompany: with dative of person(s), Marc 14:51, Luc 23:49; before μετά, with genitive of person(s), Marc 5:37.†

G4871.def:
συν-αλίζω 
[in Al.: Psaumes 141:4 * ;] 
to assemble with: Actes 1:4 (EV, mg., eating with, but on this rendering and on the force of the Pres. ptcp. here, see Field, Notes, 110).†

G4872.def:
συν-ανα-βαίνω 
[in LXX for עָלָה ;] 
to go up with: with dative of person(s), before εἰς, with accusative loc., Marc 15:41, Actes 13:31.†

G4873.def:
συν-ανά-κειμαι 
[in LXX: 3Ma.5:39 * ;] 
to recline with or together at table: Matthieu 14:9, Marc 6:22, Luc 7:49 14:15; with dative of person(s), Matthieu 9:10, Marc 2:15, Luc 14:10.†

G4874.def:
συν-ανα-μίγνυμι
(accusative to Bl., 8, -μείγνυμι), [in LXX: Osée 7:8 A ( hithpo.), Eze.20:18 A * ;] 
to mix up together; pass., reflex, and metaphorically, to associate with (Plut., Ath., al.): 1 Corinthiens 5:9 5:11, 2 Thessaloniciens 3:14 (see M, Th., 117).†

G4875.def:
συν-ανα-παύομαι 
[in LXX: Ésaïe 11:6 (רָבַץ) * ;] 
with dative of person(s), to lie down to rest with, sleep with. Metaphorical, to be refreshed in spirit with: Romains 15:32 (L, om.).†

G4876.def:
συν-αντάω, -ῶ 
[in LXX for פָּגַע, פָּגַשׁ, קָרָא, קָרָה, etc. ;] 
to meet with: with dative of person(s), Luc 9:18, 37 22:10, Actes 10:25, Hébreux 7:1, 10. Metaphorical, of events, to happen, befall (Ding. L., Plut., al.): Actes 20:22.†

G4878.def:
συν-αντι-λαμβάνομαι 
[in LXX: Genèse 30:8 R (†), Exode 18:22, Nombres 11:17 (נָשָׂא), Psaumes 89:21 (כּוּן ni.) * ;] 
to take hold with at the side for assistance; hence, to take a share in, help in bearing, and generally, help (with various constructions, see LXX, ll. with, Deiss., LAE, 83 f.): with dative, Luc 10:40, Romains 8:26.†

G4879.def:
συν-απ-άγω 
[in LXX: Exode 14:6 (לָקַח) * ;] 
to lead away with or together (Ex, l.with). Pass., metaphorically (as συμπεριφέρομαι, see LS, see word), to be carried away with: with dative, Galates 2:13, 2 Pierre 3:17; of accommodating one­self to (EV, condescend to) things or persons (on the meaning, see ICC, in I.; Field, Notes, 163), Romains 12:16.†

G4880.def:
συν-απο-θνήσκω 
[in LXX: Sir.19:10 * ;] 
to die with or together: Marc 14:31, 2 Corinthiens 7:3 (see Meyer, in l), 2 Timothée 2:11.†

G4881.def:
συν-απ-όλλυμι 
[in LXX chiefly for סָפָה ;] 
to destroy with or together. Pass., to perish together (with): with dative of person(s), Hébreux 11:31.†

G4882.def:
συν-απο-στέλλω 
[in LXX: Exode 33:2, 12 (שָׁלַח), I Esther 5:2 * ;] 
to send along with: with accusative, 2 Corinthiens 12:18 (cf. MM, xxiv).†

G4883.def:
συν-αρμολογέω, -ῶ
(ἁρμός, λέγω), = cl. συναρμόζω, 
to fit or frame together: of the parts of a building, Éphésiens 2:21; of the members of the body, Éphésiens 4:16 (Eccl.).†

G4884.def:
συν-αρπάζω 
[in LXX: Proverbes 6:25 (לָקַח), 2Ma.3:27 2Mac 4:41, 4Ma.5:4 * ;] 
"perfective " of ἁοπάζω (see M, Pr., 113), 
__(a) to seize and carry away (so most commonly) : Actes 27:15; 
__(b) to seize and hold: Luc 8:29, Actes 6:12 19:29.†

G4885.def:
συν-αυξάνω 
[in LXX: 2Ma.4:4, 4Ma.13:27 * ;] 
to cause to increase or grow together. Pass., to grow together: Matthieu 13:30 (Xen., al.).†

G4886.def:
σύν-δεσμος, -ου, ὁ
(συνδέω), [in LXX for קֶשֶׁר, קְטַר, etc. ;] 
that which binds together, a bond: of the ligaments of the body, Colossiens 2:19. Metaphorical, σ. ἀδικίας, Actes 8:23; τ. τελειότητος, Colossiens 3:14; τ. εἰρήνης, Éphésiens 4:3 (see Lft., Col., ll. with).†

G4887.def:
συν-δέω 
[in LXX for שָׁבַץ, etc. ;] 
__(a) to bind together; 
__(b) to bind together with: pass., Hébreux 13:3.†

G4888.def:
συν-δοξάζω 
__1. to join in approving (Arist.). 
__2. In NT only, to glorify together: pass., Romains 8:17.†

G4889.def:
σύν-δουλος, -ου, ὁ 
[in LXX: Esther 4:7, 9 4:17, 23 5:3, 6 6:6, 13 (כְּנָת) * ;] 
a fellow-servant: Matthieu 18:28-33 24:49; of servants of the same divine Lord, Colossiens 1:7 4:7, Apocalypse 6:11; so of angels, Apocalypse 19:10 22:9.†

G4890.def:
συνδρομή, -ῆς, ἡ
(συντρέχω), [in LXX: Jdth.10:18, 3Ma.3:8 * ;] 
concourse, esp. of a riotous gathering: Actes 21:30 (Arist., Polyb., al.).†

G4891.def:
συν-εγείρω 
[in LXX: Exode 23:5 B2 (עָזַב), Ésaïe 14:9 (עוּר pil.), 4Ma.2:14 * ;] 
to raise together: metaphorically, of the Christian's mystical resur­rection with Christ, Éphésiens 2:6; pass., Colossiens 2:12 3:1.†

G4892.def:
συνέδριον, -ου, τό
(σύν + ἕδρα, a seat) [in LXX: Proverbes 11:13 15:22, Jérémie 15:17 (סוֹד), Psaumes 26:4 (מַת), Proverbes 22:10 (דִּין) Proverbes 26:26 (קָהָל); Proverbes 24:7 27:22 31:23, 2Ma.14:5, 4Ma.17:17 * ;] 
__1. a council (Plat., Xen., al.; LXX; in π., σ. τ. πρεσβυτέρων, Deiss., BS, 156): of a local Jewish tribunal, Matthieu 10:17, Marc 13:9. 
__2. The supreme ecclesiastical court of the Jews, the Sanhedrin (i.e. Talmudic סַנְהֵדְרִין = συνέδριον): Matthieu 5:22 26:59, Marc 14:55 15:1, Luc 22:66, Actes 5:21, 27 5:34, 41 6:12, 15 22:30 23:1, 6 23:15, 20 23:28 (WH, R, mg., om.) Actes 24:20 of a meeting of the Sanhedrin, Jean 11:47; of the place of meeting, Actes 4:15.†

G4893.def:
συν-είδησις, -εως, ἡ
(συνεῖδον), [in LXX: Ecclésiaste 10:20 (מַדָּע), Wis.17:11, Sir.42:18 א * ;] 
__1. consciousness: with genitive obj., Hébreux 10:2, 1 Pierre 2:19. 
__2. In ethical sense, innate discernment, self-judging consciousness, conscience (Stoics and late writers): Romains 2:15 9:1, 1 Corinthiens 10:29, 2 Corinthiens 1:12 4:2 5:11, 1 Timothée 4:2, Hébreux 9:14; σ. ἀγαθή, Actes 23:1, 1 Timothée 1:5 1:19, 1 Pierre 3:16 3:21; ἀσθενής, 1 Corinthiens 8:7 8:10; ἀσθενοῦσα, 1 Corinthiens 8:12; ἀπρόσκοπος, Actes 24:16; καθαρά, 1 Timothée 3:9, 2 Timothée 1:3; καλή, Hébreux 13:18; πονηρά, Hébreux 10:22; ὁ νοῦς καὶ ἡ σ., Tite 1:15; διὰ τὴν σ., Romains 13:5, 1 Corinthiens 10:25 10:27-28; κατὰ σ., Hébreux 9:9; ὑπὸ (τῆς) σ., Jean 8:1-59 [9] (Rec.), 1 Corinthiens 10:29 (cf. Cremer, 233 ff.; ICC on Romains 2:15; DB, i, 468 ff.).†

G4894.def:
συν-εῖδον irreg. aorist of συνοράω (see: εἶδον), 
[in LXX: 1Ma.4:21 א, 2Ma.2:24 2Mac 4:4 2Mac 4:41 R 2Ma.5:17 2Mac 7:4 2Mac 7:20 2Mac 8:8, 3Ma.2:8 A * ;] 
__1. to see together or at the same time (Arist., Xen.). 
__2. to see in one view, hence, of mental vision, to comprehend, understand (LXX, Polyb., Plut., al.) : Actes 12:12 14:6 (on the related σύνοιδα, see see word).†

G4895.def:
σύν-ειμι
(εἰμί to be), [in LXX: Jérémie 3:20 (רֵעַ), al. ;] 
to be with: Luc 9:18 (WH, mg., συνήντησαν), Actes 22:11.†

G4896.def:
σύν-ειμι
(εἶμι, to go), 
to come together: Luc 8:4.†

G4897.def:
συν-εισ-έρχομαι 
[in LXX: Job 22:4 (עִם בּוֹא), etc. ;] 
to enter together: with dative of person(s), before εἰς, with accusative loc., Jean 6:22 18:15.†

G4898.def:
συν-έκδημος, -ου, ὁ
(ἔκδημος, abroad), 
a fellow-traveller: Actes 19:29, 2 Corinthiens 8:1.†

G4899.def:
συν-εκ-λεκτός, -ή, -όν 
chosen together with, co-elect: ἡ ἐν Βαβυλῶνι συνεκλεκτή (on the meaning, see ICC, in l), 1 Pierre 5:13.†
